description: CRITICAL: Only include the fields listed below. Do NOT add any other fields. The LLM must generate test cases with ONLY these fields.

test_case_structure.name: REQUIRED - Short descriptive name of the test case

driving_state.description: REQUIRED if operation has dependencies, otherwise null. Contains ONLY the fields needed to execute a valid setup request.
driving_state.method: REQUIRED - HTTP method (PUT, POST, GET, DELETE)
driving_state.request_body: REQUIRED - Valid JSON request body that would succeed. Omit if method is GET or DELETE.

request.description: REQUIRED - The invalid request that violates the constraint. Contains ONLY the fields needed to execute the HTTP request.
request.method: REQUIRED - HTTP method (PUT, POST, GET, DELETE)
request.request_body: REQUIRED - Invalid JSON request body that violates the constraint. Omit if method is GET or DELETE.

test_case_structure.violated_constraints: REQUIRED - Array with exactly one string: the constraint being violated

do_not_include: query_parameters (unless absolutely necessary for GET requests)
Any other fields not explicitly listed above
focus_only_on: driving_state - if needed, only resource_url, method, headers.Content-Type, request_body
request - only resource_url, method, headers.Content-Type, request_body
violated_constraints - array with one constraint string
